_comment: Mine Site Task Management — Flow 4: Execution Day Morning Briefing
_instructions: Build this as a Scheduled cloud flow in Power Automate using Document 6 as your guide.

flow.name: MineTasks_Flow4_ExecutionDayBriefing
flow.description: Runs every day at 6:00 AM. Queries all WorkTasks with Scheduled Date = today and Status = 'Scheduled'. Updates each to 'In Progress', sends a Teams Adaptive Card execution briefing to each supervisor, posts to department channel, and emails Mine Manager with daily summary.

trigger.timezone: (UTC+10:00) Brisbane — CHANGE TO YOUR LOCAL TIMEZONE

actions.name: SendExecutionDayCard
actions.type: Teams - Post Adaptive Card to user
actions.recipient: Assigned Supervisor Email from task item
actions.description: Sends a prominent execution-day briefing card with task details and a direct link to mark complete

actions.name: PostToTodaysTasksChannel
actions.message: Live task briefing with department, supervisor, start time, crew, and equipment

actions.name: SendManagerDailySummary
actions.description: After loop — sends a single consolidated daily summary to Mine Manager
actions.subject: [DAILY TASK BRIEFING] @{variables('TodayDateDisplay')} — @{length(body('GetTodaysTasks')?['value'])} Active Tasks
actions.body: Summary of all tasks active today with link to SharePoint

flow.advancedNote: For shift-based timing, create 3 separate versions of this flow: Flow4a (6AM, Day Shift filter), Flow4b (12PM, Afternoon Shift filter), Flow4c (4PM, Night Shift filter)
